decisions.executionNote: Approach blue nut with left arm, raising and gradually pitching into elbow-up top grasp. Right stays clear; nut location estimated from calibrated head view.
Finish vertical grasp orientation and move above blue nut on left side of center, keeping right arm parked.
Descend vertically to blue nut grasp height, close fully, and lift slightly to check retention visually.
Blue nut appears retained between fingers. Lift to clearance and carry leftward above the matching blue bolt without crossing the center.
Lower blue nut toward bolt entry while raising right arm into a continuous elbow-up approach for purple. Check blue alignment before tightening.
Correct blue nut slightly toward visible shaft and begin slow clockwise engagement. Right approaches purple nut from its own side; estimated table-height geometry updated from reference.
Fine-correct blue toward shaft using wrist view, continue limited clockwise turn then release for regrasp. Lower right onto purple nut and close; retention will be checked.
Reset left wrist while open for another blue tightening stroke. Lift purple nut and carry it rightward toward matching bolt, checking retention in next image.
Purple was not retained and blue appears tilted, so pause tightening. Regrasp/lift blue to inspect, and return right above the visible dropped purple nut for a better-centered pickup.

Blue now appears seated around its shaft; descend open and regrasp. Right lowers before small centering correction to avoid the previous extension/continuity limit, stopping open to inspect purple grasp alignment.
Apply another clockwise blue tightening stroke while cap is centered, then release. Make a small wrist-based purple centering adjustment, close fully and test retention with a short lift.
Purple appears retained after test lift; carry it rightward at clearance toward its bolt. Raise left fingers clear and reset wrist open for another controlled blue tightening stroke.
Regrasp seated blue nut and tighten clockwise with small descent. Bring retained purple nut over its shaft and lower to an inspection height before threading.
Blue cap is centered and nearly flush; release and reset for final check. Center purple over visible shaft, lower gently, and begin clockwise threading with closed grip.
Finish a short blue tightening stroke and release. Improve purple lateral centering using remaining shaft offset, finish first clockwise stroke, and release to inspect seating.
Blue appears flush after release; clear it with left arm and wait on the left side for red. Raise and reset right wrist open before regrasping purple for deeper tightening.
Purple has tipped rather than seated. Stop threading and regrasp it with a small centering correction, then lift clear for visual inspection and reorientation; left remains clear.
Purple settled upright around its shaft after recovery; open, center over the now-visible cap, descend to its outer flats and regrasp for tightening.
Tighten centered purple nut clockwise and release. Move left to a clear waiting position on its side, preparing for the red nut handover.
Purple remains upright and centered after release. Reset right wrist open above the nut, then return to the flats for another controlled tightening stroke.
Apply another clockwise purple tightening stroke with minimal axial descent, then open. Inspect that the cap stays centered and the nut remains upright.
Purple appears seated after release. Clear it and reset right wrist while moving above the red nut, which must be staged at center for the left arm.
Lower open right gripper toward red nut with a small wrist-based lateral correction. Stop just above grasp height to verify centering before closing.
Make a small red-nut centering correction, descend to grasp height, close fully and test with a short vertical lift before transport.
Red was not retained; reopen and approach the shifted nut with a small correction toward the wrist image's lower direction. Close and test a shorter lift.
Red appears held between the fingers. Lift to clearance and begin moving toward a center staging spot; move left farther aside to keep the arms separated.
Carry retained red nut to the center without crossing arms, lower cautiously accounting for its low grasp, and release onto the table for left-arm pickup.
Red is upright at the center staging spot. Withdraw right first, then bring left above it from the left side, maintaining separation for the handover.
Center left over staged red nut and descend open to inspect grasp alignment. Right moves farther into its own workspace, clear of the handover.
Fine-center left fingers on the staged red nut, close and test retention with a short lift. Begin returning the empty right arm toward origin with continuous elbow-up motion.
Red is retained after the handover. Carry it leftward at clearance over its matching bolt while returning the empty right arm to its origin.
Align red nut laterally toward the visible shaft and lower slowly to entry height. Keep grip closed and inspect before applying threading rotation.
Corrected tensor after zero-step rejection. Fine-center red on shaft, lower gently, and begin slow clockwise engagement; right remains parked.
Finish a short red engagement stroke, open to let it settle, then lift and reset the wrist for a clear seating inspection. Retention and threading remain visually uncertain.
Red tilted after release, so stop tightening. Regrasp gently and lift a short distance to inspect and recover its alignment; replan from the interrupted pose without the discarded wrist reset.
Red settled upright around the shaft during recovery. Open, reset wrist at clearance, and center over the visible cap before descending onto the outer flats.
Regrasp the upright red nut and apply a clockwise tightening stroke with minimal axial descent, then release for seating inspection. Right remains at origin.
Red remains upright with its shaft centered. Keep both grippers open while lifting and resetting the left wrist for the next tightening stroke.
Regrasp red outer flats and add another clockwise tightening stroke with very small descent, then release. Keep the empty right hand open at origin.
Red stays upright and centered after release. Reset the open left wrist at clearance and return to the flats for one more short tightening pass.
Add a final short clockwise red tightening pass, maintaining alignment and minimal descent, then release to inspect before withdrawing to origin.
All three pairs appear upright with centered caps. Withdraw left open above red and reset wrist at clearance, preparing to return both arms to their origins.
Retract left along a continuous elbow-up path toward its earlier safe intermediate pose, gradually restoring home orientation. Both hands remain open and clear of the assembled pairs.
Return the open left arm along the reverse of its safe initial approach, preserving elbow-up continuity and keeping clear of all three assembled pairs.
